family.description: CSS font-family value. Figure defaults prefer real installed Arial for all typography. Arial requests use real installed Arial when available; otherwise explicitly switch to bundled Arimo, reflow and report the actual font in normalized options, warnings and SVG metadata. Arial remains a system-font reference in SVG; fallback Arimo subsets are embedded. Georgia, Times, Helvetica and PingFang legacy requests map to bundled alternatives whose required subsets are embedded.

clade_id.description: Stable group identifier. Omit on creation to let PhyloRender assign one.

mrca_of.description: One tip label defines a single-sample group; multiple tip labels define the colored MRCA clade.

name_segments.description: Consecutive rich-text parts of one clade-bar label. Their text values are concatenated in order; when name is also supplied, it must equal that concatenation exactly.

text.description: Exact text for this consecutive part of the clade-bar label. Spaces may be retained at either edge to separate adjacent parts.

family.description: Font family for only this text segment. Omit to inherit the global clade-label font.

size.description: Font size in SVG pixels for only this segment. Omit to inherit the global clade-label size.

size_pt.description: Legacy point-reference font size, converted to drawing units; scales with print width. Prefer size_u.

size_u.description: Font size in drawing units. The complete figure width is 1000 units; this field supersedes legacy size_pt.

color.description: Text color for only this segment of one group. Omit to inherit that group's color; there is no global clade-label color.

bold.description: Set true or false to override boldness for this segment. Omit to inherit the global clade-label weight.

italic.description: Set true or false to override italics for this segment. Omit to inherit the global clade-label style.

label_orientation.description: Default auto: prefer compact rotated labels in aligned Dating/cloud groups; nearby phylogeny groups retain horizontal labels when they fit unused name space. Overlapping groups use separate columns. Explicit horizontal/vertical remains fixed.

bar_style.description: Clade bracket line style. Default auto uses solid bars for single-layer or innermost clades, cap-locked dashed vertical bars with solid horizontal end caps for first-level outer clades, and dash-dot bars for higher-order outer clades.

tier.description: Optional explicit bracket tier (0 = innermost column, 1 = first outer column, etc.) so peer taxonomic ranks such as subfamilies align in the same outer dashed column even when some lack annotated subclades. Null or omitted derives tier automatically from clade nesting.

branch_id.description: Stable branch identifier returned by inspect_figure; never use an internal node id.

dx.description: Horizontal label-box offset from the true node in SVG pixels.

dy.description: Vertical label-box offset from the true node in SVG pixels.

title: PhyloRender figure specification: physical units
description: pt typography, em row spacing, mm figure width, DPI raster density. Legacy logical-pixel parameters remain accepted. Aggregate tree-text limits are additionally checked by the runtime.
